# Public higher-n square-packing witnesses

The donor crops are derived from exact public certificates credited to Mykhailo Polkovskyi (Mishapolk) and Kevin Fang (TheSnakeFang), together with the prior discoverers and construction authors retained in each source record. Their public source repositories carry the accompanying MIT notices. The notices are retained verbatim here.

Canonical certificate bytes were read from Francisco Couzo's public reviewed catalogue at commit `964ee2bdf301d0c8912d956d4010f478dcbbd5ea`. Couzo's complete catalogue is not claimed to have a blanket license; this experiment admits only the two above MIT-attributed source categories. Every certificate hash is checked against that catalogue's published manifest before parsing.

The retained data under `artifacts/high-n-donors/` records the full inherited manifest entries, original source repositories/commits/credits when available, certificate SHA-256, source square indices, crop windows, and conversion/dilation settings. Crops remove squares and translate the remainder; no unit square is resized. Float-coordinate conversion receives conservative centre dilation, and improving complete puzzle layouts must pass independent interval certification before use.

The local importer, crop selection and experiment orchestration are this project's work. A geometric fingerprint not seen in our finite baseline is not a new mathematical-record claim.
